This question evaluates end-to-end OTCA data governance for IoT-to-ML pipelines, assessing understanding of privacy, residency, and auditability at scale.

## Key Concepts
- OTCA data residency across regions and tenants
- Edge preprocessing and policy-driven PII masking
- Envelope encryption with per-tenant keys
- Immutable audit trails and data lineage
- Real-time streaming to a central data lake for model training

## Code Example
```python
# Per-record redaction for PII fields
def redact(record):
    for k in ("ssn", "email", "phone"):
        if k in record:
            record[k] = "REDACTED"
```
